images.title: World of Demon's Souls (archstone overview)
images.description: All five archstone worlds and their sub-levels (1-1 to 5-3) drawn to relative scale and labelled on a parchment world map; colour-coded per world. Not to geographic scale.
images.credit: u/Agabal (Reddit, Nov 2020); based on Kouryakubo level maps from demonssouls.wikidot.com
images.license: game-derived fan image from Reddit, no license stated

images.title: Demon's Souls: The Land of Boletaria (illustrated)
images.description: Illustrated isometric-style map of all five worlds plus the Nexus, with small area labels (PS3 original layouts, apply equally to the PS5 remake). Downscaled from 6216x4662.
images.credit: VGCartography (DeviantArt, Dec 2025)
images.license: game-derived fan art from DeviantArt, no license stated (DeviantArt license field: none)
